Package neqsim.thermodynamicoperations.flashops

Class EOSCGSinglePhaseVUFlash

java.lang.Object
neqsim.thermodynamicoperations.flashops.EOSCGSinglePhaseVUFlash
final class EOSCGSinglePhaseVUFlash extends Object
Solves a pure EOS-CG single-phase VU state at the density imposed by its volume.
